name: How much does AEO service typically cost for real estate agents?

mainEntity.name: How much does AEO service typically cost for real estate agents?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AEO services for real estate agents varies widely depending on the scope and intensity of the strategy. Factors include the number of service areas, content creation requirements, competitive landscape, and ongoing optimization needs. Basic packages might focus on core FAQ optimization, while comprehensive services could include in-depth content development, schema markup implementation, and regular performance monitoring. A customized quote is typically provided after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO service costs for real estate agents vary based on scope, content needs, and competitive factors; a customized quote follows an assessment.
